history.changes_cs: Jarvis dogfood pro WDUi Skin Editor doplnil SkinLibraryIdPropertyCoverage: skin-library id je bezpecna schema-backed textova vlastnost s validaci a Jarvis po dokonceni rezu korektne zastavi jako planning pass.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis ma novy recovery self-test pro prerusene worker journaly a release build overuje, ze obnova rozdelane prace nebere ukoncene nebo spatne pojmenovane zaznamy.
history.changes_en: Jarvis adds a recovery self-test for interrupted worker journals, and the release build verifies that work recovery ignores completed or malformed job records.

history.changes_cs: Pridava okno Obnova prace v menu Nastroje: prerusene ulohy jdou zkontrolovat, znovu zaradit, oznacit jako opustene nebo exportovat bez spamovani chatu.
history.changes_en: Adds a Work recovery window under Tools: interrupted jobs can be reviewed, safely requeued, marked abandoned, or exported without spamming the chat.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis pridava dialog Sdilene pracovni povedomi: v Nastroje lze zobrazit relevantni zdrojove chaty ze stejneho projektu, precist si duvod relevance a otevrit zdrojovy chat bez spamovani konverzace.
history.changes_en: Jarvis adds a Shared work awareness dialog: Tools can show relevant source chats from the same project, explain why they matter, and open the source chat without spamming the conversation.

history.changes_en: Jarvis was republished on request with the current CPM/WDUi state and a fresh setup/update manifest.

history.changes_en: Jarvis was published on request with the current CPM/WDUi state, setup package, and ADPU update manifest.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis lepe predava SharedWork zdroje modelu: prompt obsahuje duvody shody a pravidlo, ze jde jen o read-only kontext z jinych chatu.
history.changes_en: Jarvis now passes SharedWork sources to the model with relevance reasons and an explicit read-only other-chat rule.

history.changes_cs: Diagnostika Jarvise ukazuje SharedWork zdroje, ze kterych worker pri odpovedi cerpal.
history.changes_en: Jarvis diagnostics now show SharedWork sources used by the worker while answering.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis byl publikovan na vyzadani s aktualnim stavem CPM a WDUi artefaktu.
history.changes_en: Jarvis was published on request with the current CPM and WDUi artifact state.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis byl publikovan s aktualnim buildem, setupem, checksumem a pripravou sdileneho pracovního povedomi mezi chaty.
history.changes_en: Jarvis was published with the current build, setup, checksum, and shared work awareness preparation between chats.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis uklada worker checkpointy do Sdileneho pracovniho povedomi a dalsim chatum ve stejnem projektu pridava kratky read-only kontext z jinych chatu bez prava je ukolovat.
history.changes_en: Jarvis now publishes worker checkpoints into Shared Work Awareness and adds concise same-project read-only context from other chats without allowing chats to assign work to each other.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis byl publikovan s aktualni WDUi build-info integraci a roadmapou Sdileneho pracovniho povedomi bez regrese verejne verze. Build cesta Jarvise kompiluje WDUi vcetne DesignUiBuildInfo.cpp a release setup navazuje na predchozi 0.1.479 opravy.
history.changes_en: Jarvis was published with the current WDUi build-info integration and Shared Work Awareness roadmap without regressing the public version. The Jarvis build path compiles WDUi including DesignUiBuildInfo.cpp and the release setup builds on the previous 0.1.479 fixes.

history.changes_cs: Diagnostika Jarvise nově exportuje souhrn agentické stopy: poslední úkol, routing, použitý model, policy/executor průběh a poslední problém bez zahlcení běžného chatu.
history.changes_en: Jarvis diagnostics now export an agent trace summary: latest job, routing, selected model, policy/executor flow, and last problem without cluttering normal chat.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis napojuje workspace souborove akce na PolicyExecutor: /read, /explain, /review-file a potvrzene /apply-patch ted zapisuji executor.policy trace. /apply-patch bez --confirm se odmita pres file-write boundary, ne jen textovou hlaskou.
history.changes_en: Jarvis connects workspace file actions to PolicyExecutor: /read, /explain, /review-file, and confirmed /apply-patch now write executor.policy traces. /apply-patch without --confirm is rejected through the file-write boundary, not just a text shortcut.

history.changes_cs: PolicyExecutor rozlisuje workspace file read/list a potvrzovane file mutation akce; souborove kroky uz nejsou maskovane jako shell/process.
history.changes_en: PolicyExecutor now distinguishes workspace file read/list from confirmed file mutation actions; file steps are no longer treated as shell/process launches.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis pridal guard pro bezny chat: pred zobrazenim odpovedi overi, ze model neodpovida na stary ukol, ukazkovy normalize_status kod, interni router log nebo spatne tvrzeni o PowerShellu. Pokud odpoved ujede od posledniho dotazu, Jarvis ji zkusi prepsat z aktualni zpravy a spatnou verzi nezobrazi.
history.changes_en: Jarvis adds an ordinary chat response guard: before showing an answer it checks that the model did not drift into an old task, sample normalize_status code, internal router logs, or an incorrect PowerShell capability claim. If the answer drifts from the latest user request, Jarvis rewrites it from the current message and does not show the bad draft.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis rozsiril sdileny PolicyExecutor z lokalniho shellu i na workspace build/test presety a Git. Build, test, git status/diff/log, commit a push ted pred procesem zapisuji executor.policy trace a pouzivaji stejnou preflight hranici pro potvrzeni, workspace, dostupny nastroj a opravneni.
history.changes_en: Jarvis extends the shared PolicyExecutor from local shell commands to workspace build/test presets and Git. Build, test, git status/diff/log, commit, and push now write an executor.policy trace before process launch and use the same preflight boundary for confirmation, workspace, available tool, and permissions.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis pridava prvni UI-neutralni policy gate pro lokalni executor: PowerShell, Command Prompt, Git Bash a WSL se pred spustenim jednotne kontroluji na potvrzeni, Plny pristup, platny workspace, dostupny nastroj a auditovatelnou launch hranici.
history.changes_en: Jarvis adds the first UI-neutral policy gate for the local executor: PowerShell, Command Prompt, Git Bash, and WSL now share pre-launch checks for confirmation, Full access, valid workspace, available tool, and an auditable launch boundary.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis zpevnuje dogfood/eval smycku: self-test ted hlida katalog 20 konverzacnich scenaru a povinne kategorie proti driftu od aktualni zpravy, projektu, souboru, jazyka, shell schopnosti a failure surface.
history.changes_en: Jarvis hardens the dogfood/eval loop: the self-test now enforces a catalog of 20 conversation scenarios and required coverage categories against drift from the current message, project, files, language, shell capability, and failure surface.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis pridava privacy-first diagnostiku: lokalni technicke udalosti, sanitizovany export diagnostickeho balicku na vyzadani a opt-in stav anonymni telemetrie bez automatickeho odesilani obsahu.
history.changes_en: Jarvis adds privacy-first diagnostics: local technical events, a sanitized on-demand diagnostic export package, and opt-in anonymous telemetry state without automatically uploading content.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis si u netrivialnich agentickych dotazu pripravi kratky plan navazany na aktualni zadani, podklady, opravneni a overeni, aby lepe drzel smer prace.
history.changes_en: Jarvis now prepares a short plan for non-trivial agent requests, tied to the current request, evidence, permissions, and verification, so it keeps the work on track.
